articles.title: Bhutan ‘doesn’t recall’ selling any bitcoin, disputing widely tracked $1 billion BTC drawdown
articles.snippet: Arkham Intelligence data shows that over $1 billion in bitcoin has left wallets attributed to Bhutan in the past year, flowing to exchanges and trading firms. The country says it has not sold any.

articles.title: U.S. House lawmakers who oversee the CFTC are urging Trump to fill the commission
articles.snippet: As the Commodity Futures Trading Commission takes on a growing task to police U.S. crypto trading, senior lawmakers are saying it needs bipartisan leadership.

articles.title: SpaceX targets June 11 IPO pricing, picks Nasdaq for historic market debut
articles.snippet: Elon Musk’s rocket and satellite company has accelerated plans for its blockbuster public offering, with trading expected to begin as early as June 12 after a faster-than-expected SEC review.

articles.title: House committee leaders urge Trump to nominate CFTC members, citing CLARITY Act
articles.snippet: The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission is currently headed by Chair Michael Selig, with no public statement from Donald Trump about fully staffing the five-member panel of commissioners.

articles.title: ICE, CME press US regulators to 'rein in' Hyperliquid energy trading: Report
articles.snippet: The Hyperliquid decentralized exchange allows anyone who stakes 500,000 HYPE tokens, valued at roughly $22.2 million, to deploy new markets.
